title: Visual analysis
description: The machine-readable half of the reference analysis, at examples/<project>/revisions/<id>/visual-analysis.json. It carries the parts later stages have to address by name — the named regions, the relational geometry, the anchor relationships, the shape-ownership cases and the open questions. visual-analysis.md keeps the prose observations. Per prompts/visual-analyzer-agent.md the analysis describes the page in RATIOS and DEPENDENCIES, not pixels, and it must not pick GraphCompose primitives — that is the Architecture Mapper's job.

schemaVersion.description: On-disk contract version for this artifact.

margins.description: Margins expressed relationally where possible, e.g. "~7% of page width".

regions.description: Named regions of the reference, in reading order. Every later artifact addresses regions by these ids: architecture-plan.json maps region -> render method, and visual-review.json reports mismatches per region.

contains.description: Elements inside the region, named the way a reader would name them.

proportions.description: The region's share of its parent, as a ratio or weight — never a pixel width. E.g. "0.31 of the content row".

layoutProportions.description: The page described in ratios and dependencies. Base constants derived from these land in architecture-plan.json.

anchors.description: Every element whose placement depends on another element, stated as a relationship rather than an offset. The Architecture Mapper turns each into a named engine primitive (LayerAlign, TextAlign, weights(...), ...).

relationship.description: E.g. "centred on", "pinned to the top-right of", "baseline-aligned with".

region.description: Region id this anchor belongs to.

shapeOwnership.description: Mandatory for the five cases prompts/visual-analyzer-agent.md names: initials or icons inside circles, text inside pills or badges, content inside rounded cards, images clipped by rounded or circular shapes, and badges anchored inside or on a shape boundary.

colors.description: Colour roles rather than a raw swatch list, so the theme tokens in architecture-plan.json have something to map to.

assets.description: What the Asset Resolver will have to fetch. The authoritative request is asset-request.json.

unclearParts.description: Where the reference could not be read with confidence. prompts/visual-analyzer-agent.md forbids silently guessing, so an assumption recorded here is the contract for what was assumed.
